name: patch_tick
description: Cheat-Engine-style value freeze: 20 WriteProcessMemory writes at 50ms intervals against TestTarget's `value` variable. Simulates a trainer that continuously restamps a game state to a target value. The fingerprint is a burst of ~20 WRITEVM_REMOTE events over ~1 second, distinguishing this pattern from a single one-shot write.

extra.notes: 20 ticks × 50ms = 1s of writes, then verify. Expected fingerprint delta vs patch_direct: threatint_cross_process_write_count ≈ 20 (vs 1 for direct). Total ETW-TI event count increases proportionally. No protection changes (no --restore-protection), so threatint_remote_protect_observed stays False.
